meta.description: Entrance, counselling, professional and eligibility exams referenced by pathways and careers. Government recruitment exams are in govtJobs.json.
meta.disclaimer: Curated for EduSelect from official and reputable public sources (compiled 2026-10-04). Fees and private-sector salaries are estimates (isEstimate=true) and must be shown with an 'Estimate' badge. Government pay is from the 7th CPC pay matrix (basic pay, excludes DA/HRA). Exam rules, age limits and fees change every cycle - re-check the official notification before relying on any value.

sources.title: National Testing Agency (JEE Main, NEET-UG, CUET, NCET, NCHM JEE, UGC NET)
Directorate General of Training (ITI trades, NCVT)

meta.note: officialSite values point to the conducting body's main site; always link to the current year's notification.

items.name: USMLE Step 1
items.purpose: Foundational medical licensure assessment (Pass/Fail standard)
items.eligibility: Enrolled in or graduated from ECFMG-accredited medical school (MBBS)
items.note: Fee: $695 + $210 international surcharge + 18% Indian GST (~₹99,510 total in India)

items.name: USMLE Step 2 CK (Clinical Knowledge)
items.purpose: Clinical knowledge assessment for US medical residency match (Score 230+ general, 245+ competitive)
items.eligibility: Passage of preclinical curriculum in ECFMG-accredited medical school
items.note: Fee: $695 + $235 international surcharge + 18% Indian GST (~₹1,02,021 total in India)

items.name: USMLE Step 3
items.purpose: Final examination for unsupervised medical practice licensure in the United States
items.note: Fee: $955 (~₹88,815). Administered exclusively within the United States

items.name: PLAB 1 / UK MLA Written
items.purpose: Overseas medical graduate licensure assessment for NHS practice
items.eligibility: Primary Medical Qualification (MBBS) + IELTS 7.5 or OET Grade B
items.note: Fee: £283 (~₹35,941). 180 single-best-answer questions

items.name: PLAB 2 / UK MLA Clinical (OSCE)
items.purpose: Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) in Manchester, UK
items.note: Fee: £1,036 (~₹1,31,572). 16 clinical scenario stations assessing NHS standard practice

items.name: OET Medicine (Occupational English Test)
items.purpose: Healthcare-specific language proficiency for ECFMG, GMC, and international licensure
items.note: Fee: $455 (~₹38,220). Tests listening, reading, writing, and speaking in clinical context

items.name: NCLEX-RN (National Council Licensure Examination)
items.conductingBody: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
items.purpose: Licensure examination for Registered Nurses in the USA and Canada
items.eligibility: B.Sc Nursing / GNM graduate approved by State Board of Nursing
items.note: Fee: $200 + $150 international scheduling fee (~₹29,750). Universally required across all 50 US states

items.name: CGFNS VisaScreen Credential Evaluation
items.purpose: Mandatory federal immigration credential screening for healthcare workers (EB-3 / I-140 visa)
items.eligibility: Foreign-educated registered nurses and healthcare professionals
items.note: Fee: $540 (~₹45,360). Processing time 3–6 months; universally required by US immigration law

items.name: JLPT (Japanese-Language Proficiency Test - N4/N3)
items.purpose: Japanese language qualification for Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) visas and employment
items.note: N4 meets legal threshold for SSW Type 1; employers often require N3 for technical and railway roles

items.name: Japan Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) Skills Evaluation
items.conductingBody: Relevant Japanese Sectoral Ministries (MLIT, METI, MHLW)
items.purpose: Vocational competency evaluation for 16-19 industrial sectors in Japan
items.eligibility: Age 18+; technical competence in relevant trade
items.frequency: Multiple test windows per year in India & Japan
items.note: Nursing Care sector requires specialized Japanese test with 73% passing standard from April 2026

items.name: APS Certificate (Akademische Prüfstelle)
items.purpose: Mandatory document authenticity verification for Indian students applying for German national visa
items.eligibility: Students with Indian educational qualifications applying to German universities
items.note: Non-refundable fee: EUR 225 (~₹23,025). Direct verification via DigiLocker and issuing universities

items.name: KPSC Gazetted Probationers (KAS)
items.purpose: State civil services recruitment for Assistant Commissioners, DSPs, and Tahsildars in Karnataka
items.note: Prelims (400m, 0.25 neg) -> Mains (1,250m descriptive, 7 papers) -> Interview (25m, total 1,275m)

items.name: Karnataka Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) Examination
items.purpose: Uniformed executive officer entry into Karnataka Civil, CAR, and KSISF police forces
items.eligibility: Graduate, age 21–30 years, strict height and endurance benchmarks
items.note: PST/ET physical fitness -> Paper 1 descriptive (50m) -> Paper 2 objective (150m, 0.375 neg)

items.name: BARC Online CBT / GATE for Scientific Officer
items.purpose: Selection for OCES 1-year training and DGFS 2-year fellowship leading to Group A Scientist in DAE
items.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech or M.Sc with min 60% aggregate marks
items.note: Screening via GATE score or BARC CBT, followed by rigorous technical interview. Stipend: ₹74,000/mo

items.name: PMRF Selection Review
items.conductingBody: National Coordinating Institute (IIT Madras / IIT Delhi)
items.purpose: Prime Minister's Research Fellows award for elite doctoral research in India
items.eligibility: Direct entry from CFTIs (CGPA ≥ 8.0) or lateral entry for enrolled PhD scholars
items.frequency: Twice a year (May and December cycles)
items.note: Monthly stipend ₹70,000–₹80,000 + ₹2 Lakhs annual research contingency grant (₹10 Lakhs total)

items.name: IELTS Academic (International English Language Testing System)
items.purpose: English language proficiency requirement for international admissions, APS Germany, and global licensure
items.eligibility: Open to all students and professionals
items.note: Band 6.5–7.5 typically required for Germany, UK NHS, and North American universities

items.name: GRE (Graduate Record Examinations)
items.purpose: Graduate school admission test for Master's and PhD programs globally
items.eligibility: Undergraduate degree or in final year
items.note: Assesses verbal reasoning, quantitative reasoning, and analytical writing

items.name: DCET (Karnataka Diploma Common Entrance Test)
items.purpose: Lateral entry admission to 2nd year / 3rd semester B.E./B.Tech courses in Karnataka engineering colleges
items.eligibility: Pass in 3-year Diploma in Engineering with at least 45% aggregate (40% for reserved categories)
items.note: State-level entrance enabling polytechnic and GTTC diploma holders to transition into engineering degrees
